blurb: Guests can enjoy private fishing charters targeting various species inshore, offshore, backcountry, or fly fishing. Scalloping trips include snorkeling and hunting scallops in shallow waters with an in-water guide. Sunset cruises offer scenic tours to watch the sunset and see local wildlife on a private boat.
